title: Recover sharp Schur kernel sectors directly from original header data
body:
Prove that a sharp identity-pivot Schur deletion has joint kernel-sector dimensions `(r00, r10-d, r01-d, r11-d)`, where the r values are the original commuting pair's sector dimensions. This supplies the missing input to the complete central-class classifier directly from the original header. It removes a full residual-kernel calculation from that interface. The complete kappa calculation and selected frontier remain unchanged.

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c3d939cbd06edef8bcb1c90f278c0d76f1ac2dd/research/schur-header-kernel-sectors/PROOF.md), [constructive implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c3d939cbd06edef8bcb1c90f278c0d76f1ac2dd/research/schur-header-kernel-sectors/header.py), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c3d939cbd06edef8bcb1c90f278c0d76f1ac2dd/research/schur-header-kernel-sectors/RESULT.json), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c3d939cbd06edef8bcb1c90f278c0d76f1ac2dd/research/schur-header-kernel-sectors/SOURCES.json) define the result.

Let P0,Q0 be commuting idempotents over any field, with a common identity pivot of size d and Schur residuals S,T satisfying rank(ST-TS)=2d. Write the header split as i,pi with `pi*i=I`. The four joint residual eigenspaces are `(I-i*pi)V00` and `Vab intersect ker(pi)` for the other three original sectors. They form a direct sum equal to the commutator kernel. Thus the predecessor's opposite-sector count is

```text
a1 = r10+r01-2d
   = rank(P0)+rank(Q0)-2*rank(P0*Q0)-2d.
```

`H=pi*P0*Q0*i` can be arbitrary. The theorem includes characteristic two, eigenvalue-one components and singular or empty 00 factors. Sharpness is required; an explicit nonsharp header violates the formula. The original profile must be supplied or computed, with its acquisition cost still paid. This does not classify the full ordered pair, give header probabilities or later-guard behavior, or supply a native implementation.

This answers the original-header question in Ali Romman's [PR #5287](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5287), consumed at `d17a8b3d237a8cb8685cc108bf2bb17dfea0ca78`. Its central classifier and complete-invariant oracle are unchanged. Nick Petalas's [PR #4746](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4746) supplies the sharp-sector criterion. @ssafwann supplied the commutator-image action in [PR #5256](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5256) and the nilpotent extension and factor specialization in [PR #5267](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5267). The [retained notice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c3d939cbd06edef8bcb1c90f278c0d76f1ac2dd/research/schur-header-kernel-sectors/NOTICE.md) and [retained sharp-factor proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/8c3d939cbd06edef8bcb1c90f278c0d76f1ac2dd/research/schur-header-kernel-sectors/vendor/NILPOTENT-SOURCE.md) preserve the wider lineage. General projector and Schur-complement facts are classical. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Base: current main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7. Eight byte-exact predecessor files are retained at ancestor `d725afce0f17a468cb76466a59348c611eb87ac2`; the replay needs no unmerged upstream object.

Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/schur-header-kernel-sectors
```

Both registered isolated, warning-strict normal and optimized runs pass with `PASS_SCHUR_HEADER_KERNEL_SECTORS`. The check covers 1,244 H matrices in seven complete finite domains, 98 additional cases, a separate empty-00 case and six rejection or necessity controls. It builds full projectors and headers, checks the actual pivot and sharp commutator rank, and compares the constructed bases with independent full residual kernels and complete central similarity invariants. Four actual code mutations fail in both modes before receipt comparison.

Committed bytes, every declared source pin's direct ancestry, official export integrity and both read-only Git-free replays pass; all 18 exported files remain unchanged. The implementation supports F2,F3,F5,F7; the written theorem is over every field. The full-history wrapper remains unpassed in this shallow checkout. No independent human/proof-kernel review, selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, native tape or complete caller/compiler/kappa test was run. The next consumer must state whether it needs the central class or the full ordered-pair extension data and must pay header selection and emission.

Hosted [run 39999280092](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39999280092) passed planning and the registered Linux replay for published head `8c3d939cbd06edef8bcb1c90f278c0d76f1ac2dd`. Hosted execution is separate from independent scientific review.
